recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit. No FHIR core follow-up is needed unless a later work-group decision changes ResearchSubject search parameter naming or semantics.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 change request asking to query ResearchSubject resources by a particular ResearchStudy; the Jira resolution states that a ResearchStudy search parameter was added to ResearchSubject and published in the December 2017 FHIR build.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-13847. The current XML search-parameter source includes ResearchSubject-study, and pickaxe history shows that parameter was present when the ResearchSubject XML search-parameter bundle entered the current source layout in 33b409a4b6 and was retained in the R4B draft import c69d71aa21. The Jira snapshot supplies the earlier Dec 2017 publication statement.
additional_context: ResearchSubject is in the active [resources] list in source/fhir.ini. Its study element is a required Reference to ResearchStudy, and the ResearchSubject search-parameter bundle defines code study with expression ResearchSubject.study. Broader searches found FHIR-15921 about research-related search criteria on request/event resources and FHIR-26869 about ResearchSubject.consent, but neither supersedes or changes this ResearchSubject.study search parameter. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion or minutes for this issue.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current build-scope source already satisfies the issue request by providing a ResearchSubject study reference search parameter.
